variety_description: A high-yielding, early maturity, medium tall, long slender heavy grain mega variety, grown extensively in India under Irrigated lowland conditions. Developed and released in 2000 by ANGRAU (Maruteru) by hybridization of a local variety ‘Krishnaveni’ with IR64, a popular rice variety from IRRI. Excellent productive tillering and sturdy stem. Susceptible to leaf and sheath blight and BPH. Tolerant to leaf blast.
